lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

King Charles III called the transatlantic slave trade a “shameful chapter of history” during a speech Tuesday at the official opening of the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting in Antigua, The Associated Press reports.

The Bloc Québécois is making a budget request calling on Mark Carney’s government to double its benefit designed to help households cope with higher-than-ever prices on grocery store shelves, The Canadian Press reports.
Alberta Premier Danielle Smith is defending a proposal to redraw provincial boundaries in a way the Opposition NDP says is cheating.
The City of Winnipeg is investigating what caused the spillage of nearly 10 million litres of sewage in the Red River early Monday morning, The Canadian Press reports.
Americans head to the polls Tuesday to vote in U.S. midterm elections that will serve as a referendum on President Donald Trump’s chaotic and controversial second term, The Canadian Press reports.
Justice Department identifies potential targets as it escalates Alaska Senate criminal probe, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
